checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: One square finished social graphic is delivered.
Short readable English headline encouraging beach cleanup.
must.why: 'Love Your Beach. Clean It Up!' is large and legible.
Text is rendered in the image.

must.item: Illustration depicts beach and cleanup activity.
must.why: Volunteers with gloves and bags pick up bottles on a beach.

faults.what: Minor anatomy oddities: the raised hand of the woman at right is awkward, and the bag held by the boy and woman is slightly ambiguous. Overall acceptable.
Resolution is only 640px, which is low for social use.

summary: A bright, friendly square beach clean-up illustration with a correctly spelled, embedded headline and volunteers collecting litter; only minor imperfections and low resolution.
